notes.title: Patch 1.05.2 is now available
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Patch 1.05.2, which until now has been available only as [url=https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/darkest-hour-patch-1-05-2-hot-fix-release.1530186/]download[/url] from our game [url=https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/forums/darkest-hour.554/]subforum[/url] at Paradox, is now available and set as the default version on Steam.

[b]Addressed issues:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Removed unit and brigade types and models limitation to allow values above 127 to be used. Fixed crash on start building custom units of type u_88 or above.
[*] Province improvements ordered from province panel with Ctrl, Shift or Shift+Ctrl (build to the max) sometimes are one level less (for example order 8 instead of 9 infra levels for prov with 10% infra)
[*] Fix CTD on automatic brigade detach from unit in redeployment pool on upgrade to another unit type - 1.02 bug
[*] Fixes various issues with expeditionary forces left under command of another country indefinitely. Reclaim and return all expeditionary forces on:
 - separate peace
 -  making a country puppet
 -  country ban from alliance
[*] Recalculate alliance leader when old alliance leader is:
 - made a puppet
 - annexed
[*] Fix not deleted units in redeployment pool on accepted peace with forced disarmament clause.
[*] Fix issue with auto creation of resource convoy from oversea puppets when the puppet country has own convoys. (for example ENG puppet to GER)
[*] Fix issue with maintaining of resource convoys (no transports assigned) from oversea puppets when the puppet has no resources produced in its provinces. (for example OMN puppet to GER)
[*] Fix issue with fleets not getting experience from sunk enemy convoys.
[*] Change combat distance of convoy attack from 0km to attacking fleet's desired range.
[*] Fix issue with secedearea / secederegion commands with default/old logic ([when = 0] or no [when] specified) together with [which = -1] (secede to current controller) preventing secession of provinces - 1.02 bug
[/olist]

[b]Other changes:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Added option for air units on Naval Strike mission to attack enemy convoys.
[*] Set the country with most IC as alliance leader when the old leader is removed from the alliance (made puppet or annexed). Note: Player controlled countries still get a bonus of 100 points.
[*] Removed cost for trade deals between allied or puppet-master countries.
[/olist]

More on patch 1.05.2 can be found [url=https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/darkest-hour-patch-1-05-2-hot-fix-release.1530186/]here[/url].

We are working on new content and features for Patch 1.06, but as of now we don't have a timeline. For more details and to stay updated, please refer to the [url=https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/index.php?forums/darkest-hour.554/]Paradox forum[/url].

[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Save-games and mods for 1.04 are [b]NOT[/b] compatible with 1.05.2.
[*] Save-games and mods for 1.05 or 1.05.1 are compatible with 1.05.2.
[*]  Patch 1.05.1 and previous patches are still available on the Beta tab.
[/list]

Checksums should remain unchanged from 1.05/1.05.1:
[b]KVZZ [/b]- Darkest Hour Full
[b]TENE[/b] - Darkest Hour Light
[b]LNIC [/b]- No mods (Darkest Hour Core)

notes.title: Patch 1.05.1 now officially released
notes.content:
Patch 1.05.1, which until now has been available only as beta, is now the latest official version of Darkest Hour.

Savegames and mods for 1.04 are NOT compatible with 1.05.1.
Savegames and mods for 1.05 are compatible with 1.05.1.

The complete changelog of patch 1.05 can be found here: https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/index.php?threads/darkest-hour-dev-diary-34-patch-1-05.1058632/

For more details, please refer to the Paradox forum: https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/index.php?forums/darkest-hour.554/

Patch 1.04 and previous patches are still available on the Beta tab.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.5.1 now available
notes.content:
[b]IMPORTANT: For the moment Version 1.05.1 is available through the Beta tab (versions 1.02, 1.03 and 1.05 can be found there too) while 1.04 is still the default version (this will be changed later).[/b]

Hello everyone,

Thanks to your reports in the Paradox forum after the release of Patch 1.05 we were able to identify two issues introduced by the patch:
[olist]
[*]Fixed air and naval units mission cancellation on auto-retreat from combat – 1.05 bug
[*]Fixed issues with wrong over command penalty applied in some situations, like when unit on Anti-partisan mission attacks partisans and gets the penalty once it arrives to the rebellious province - 1.05 bug
[/olist]

As you can see, both issues could be game breakers or very irritating at least, so we decided to release an EXE only patch, aimed at addressing those. 

To install patch 1.5.1 you need to select it in the Beta tab of the properties of the game.  Version 1.5.1 is compatible with savegames from 1.5.

Checksums should remain unchanged from 1.05:
KVZZ - Darkest Hour Full
TENE - Darkest Hour Light
LNIC - No mods (Darkest Hour Core)
